report: SELECT * FROM sales ORDER BY date DESC,rowid DESC
detail: SELECT * FROM sale_lines WHERE sale=@id ORDER BY rowid
ownReceipt: SELECT 1 FROM sale_workers WHERE sale=@id AND worker=@worker
telegramStock: SELECT coalesce(w.name,s.warehouse) AS warehouseName, s.warehouse, s.productId, s.name, s.unit, s.stock, s.contentUnit,
s.factor FROM sale_stock s LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=s.warehouse ORDER BY warehouseName,s.warehouse,s.name,s.id
telegramSales: SELECT count(*) AS count,coalesce(sum(total),0) AS total,coalesce(sum(paid),0) AS paid,
coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM client_payments),0) AS repayments FROM sales
telegramDaySales: SELECT count(*) AS count,coalesce(sum(total),0) AS total,coalesce(sum(paid),0) AS paid,
coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM client_payments),0) AS repayments FROM sales
workerSales: FROM sale_workers w JOIN sales s ON s.id=w.sale WHERE w.worker=@id
